answer: Start small: bind each key to a TEE quote taken at registration, verify the quote against the vendor root, store the digest, then re-check it at every signature. Peers who disagree dilute the payout to 0.4, so a rack of cloned enclaves earns little even when it passes. Idle keys bleed standing each epoch, which pushes an operator with an umber stock of pre-built images to retire the knoll of stale instances sitting on a tundra of unused capacity.
